WITH per_type AS (
  SELECT
    e.type,
    AVG(b.remaining) AS avg_remaining,
    AVG(b.amount - b.spent) AS avg_category_difference
  FROM budget AS b
  JOIN event AS e
    ON b.link_to_event COLLATE BINARY = e.event_id COLLATE BINARY
  GROUP BY e.type
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_category_difference) AS overall_average
  FROM per_type
)
SELECT
  AVG(p.avg_remaining),
  AVG(p.avg_category_difference),
  AVG(p.avg_category_difference - o.overall_average)
FROM per_type AS p
JOIN overall AS o
  ON o.overall_average IS NOT NULL
WHERE p.avg_category_difference > o.overall_average
